data.description:
## Description

Story 20d7-09d6-b831-4c3a (under epic b575) deleted .github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml (commit 4b18d2d644, task 398c-9d6c-1fd5-4b39) to satisfy an epic-internal invariant ('exactly one llm-review pipeline per SHA' needed by cycle-ledger story 5621, arbiter dispatch story b1b6, max_cycles enforcement story 35b8).

The deleted workflow provided the project's per-story / per-batch internal LLM review surface — the SUB-PR review tier that the user has repeatedly identified as load-bearing for reliable review of large epics.

## Scope violation pattern

The epic's stated goal (b575) is cycle-end arbiter + workflow unification. It was NOT scoped to remove existing review coverage. Deleting per-branch-review.yml is a regression introduced because the new functionality interfered with the old, not because the old functionality was wrong.

The right architectural choice was to KEY THE LEDGER BY (PR, SHA) instead of SHA alone, so parallel review workflows could coexist without double-counting. Story 20d7 took the destructive path instead.

## Compounding misclosure

Story 20d7's completion-verifier caught the gap and filed bug 0091-0cf9-3840-4b00. Bug 0091 was CLOSED via commit 4c730cf6db that only edited debug-everything/SKILL.md to point at /dso:review — a skill that is HARD-GATED to no-op under dso.workflow=ci-pr. The 'fix' was documentation-only and pointed at a code path that does not run in production mode.

Tracking history:
- Original ticket: b1a7-20bf-88a1-4fb5 (closed; this is the recreation without parent)
- Original deletion task: 398c-9d6c-1fd5-4b39
- Original story: 20d7-09d6-b831-4c3a
- Misclosed gap bug: 0091-0cf9-3840-4b00

## Why this is P0

- User has repeatedly stated that every change must pass review before merging to main
- This is the SECOND critical workflow regression in this epic
- Pattern: stories that interfere with existing functionality delete the existing functionality instead of reconciling

## Resolution path

Coverage restoration is in scope of the upcoming remediation epic (will explicitly include SC to restore per-sub-PR review with no-duplicate-checks invariant via ledger keying).

This bug remains as the POST-MORTEM RECORD documenting the scope-regression pattern for future process work AFTER the remediation epic stabilizes the workflow. The bug captures the systemic issue (stories delete unrelated functionality when convenient); the remediation epic only addresses the symptom. Dedicated focused work post-remediation should investigate enforcement mechanisms that prevent this pattern (story-planning gate, scope-classification rubric, etc.) — CLAUDE.md additions are NOT effective per user direction.
data.title: Story 20d7 deleted per-branch-review.yml — unrelated functionality removed for epic invariant convenience (scope regression pattern)
